item.title: Good demand for Johanri Dormers
item.description: Demand for Dormer ewes, both commercial and stud, was particularly strong at the Johanri production auction of Johan and Anri Barnard on the farm Spioenkop near Lindley, Free State. Particularly high average prices, especially for the commercial ewes, were achieved.

item.title: FMD | Vaccination update from Gauteng
item.description: The Gauteng Department of Agriculture and Rural Development began administering its allocated share – 70 000 doses – of the first consignment of foot-and-mouth disease vaccine from Argentina on Thursday, 26 February.

item.title: WATCH | Trading in an uncertain world
item.description: In this episode of AgriView, Wandile Sihlobo, chief economist of Agbiz, analyses South Africa’s strong agricultural performance in 2025, with exports reaching a record $15.1 billion – up 10% on the previous year – despite global trade uncertainty.

item.title: FMD | Vaccination update from North West
item.description: In North West, by Friday afternoon, 27 February, none of the Argentine foot-and-mouth disease vaccine that arrived in the country last weekend had yet been administered.

item.title: How to protect your crops from extreme weather – Dr Zoleka Ncoyini
item.description: When sudden temperature drops and heavy rainfall hit South African farms, like the extreme weather witnessed this February, vegetable farmers often find themselves scrambling to protect months of hard work.

item.title: From our editor: Rain, the Soweto Derby and a new dawn for Zebediela
item.description: As a part-time farmer – what many teasingly call a “weekend farmer” – I headed to the farm this past weekend with a long to-do list and even longer expectations. There is never enough time when you juggle farming with other responsibilities, so every hour on the land counts.

item.title: Livestock farmers urged to vaccinate against Rift Valley fever
item.description: Livestock in South Africa such as sheep, goats and cattle are currently at hight risk of contracting Rift Valley fever, veterinarians and national producer organisations have warned.

item.title: FMD | New research could reduce losses for cattle farmers
item.description: A local scientist who tested meat and offal from cattle after they recovered from foot-and-mouth disease says her findings could help modernise slaughter regulations and save farmers thousands of rands per animal.
